article.story: CLINTON, S.C. -- — Rob Martin scored 14 points as High Point beat Presbyterian 79-73 on Thursday night for its 11th straight victory. Martin also had five assists for the Panthers (27-4, 15-1 Big South Conference). Terry Anderson scored 13 points while shooting 5 for 14. Owen Aquino went 5 of 9 from the field to finish with 12 points, while adding seven rebounds, three steals, and four blocks. Triston Wilson led the way for the Blue Hose (14-16, 7-8) with 17 points. Presbyterian also got 16 points from Carl Parrish. Jaylen Peterson also had 15 points, nine rebounds and three blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
